text:
alex: Heads-up — acme-corp reporting a big spike of 504s and timeouts since ~11:42 PDT during a traffic surge. Customer says ~30% requests hit 504s and others have 2-10s tail latency. Can we triage?

eva: Customer is getting pretty upset, raised a severity-2. They can reproduce from their side: steady qps ~120 -> burst to ~400 causes the failures. No config changes on their side.

billing-bot: [alert] billing-service returned 429/403 on token validation for tenant acme-corp between 11:40-11:44 (rate-limit spikes).

junaid: On it. First checks: keda ScaledObject for acme-prod and HPA metrics. Can someone paste the acme scaledobject name?

alex: scaledobject name: so-acme-prod-inference, namespace: inference-prod.

maya: quick note — last month we saw auth token refresh errors causing the KEDA scaler to stop emitting metrics. If the scaler can't read the tenant metric (403/401) it won't scale and HPA stays static. Could be auth + billing rate-limit interaction.

sre-oncall: I pulled events: "Failed to fetch external metric: unauthorized (403)" from the KEDA controller at 11:41:23. HPA stayed at minReplicas=2 while queue/backlog rose. Log snippet: 
```
E 11:41:23 keda-controller ExternalMetricFetch error tenant=acme-corp status=403 msg="token validation failed"
```

junaid: Repro steps I'm running locally to validate:
1) rotate tenant token (simulate our auth rotation)
2) send a burst to hosted-api /v1/generate with tenant headers at 350 qps for 1m
3) observe keda metrics and HPA replicas

maya: Confirmed repro in staging: when token exchange starts failing intermittently, KEDA poll returns errors and scaledobject activation doesn't trigger; HPA doesn't scale until poll succeeds again — warmup delay + the HPA cooldown makes the client see 504s.

junaid: Quick mitigation applied: bumped scaledobject pollInterval from 30s -> 10s and added retry/backoff on metrics fetch to tolerate transient 403s. Patching now:
```
kubectl patch scaledobject so-acme-prod-inference -n inference-prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/pollingInterval","value":10}]'
```

ops-bot: Deploy started by junaid: patch scaledobject so-acme-prod-inference (inference-prod) — rollout id f9c3a.

alex: Notified customer and asked them to retry. They reported partial recovery ~30s after patch, but still seeing a few 504s during peak.

billing-bot: Follow-up: billing-service throttles token validation when downstream identity load > 600 rps; suggestions: add local cache of recent tokens or circuit-breaker.

maya: Root cause summary: concurrent auth/token rotation + sudden tenant surge created a window where KEDA external metric fetch returned repeated 403s from the token validation endpoint (billing/identity throttling). That prevented the ScaledObject from activating quickly; combined with HPA warmup/cooldown we under-provisioned resulting in gateway 5xx/timeouts.

junaid: Action items:
- INF-4321: Add exponential retry + local fallback metric in KEDA scaler (maya)
- INF-4322: Add token validation caching layer and circuit-breaker in billing-service (billing team)
- INF-4323: Add prewarm annotation suggestions to customer onboarding docs for known bursty tenants (devex)

maya: I'll own INF-4321 and put an immediate follow-up PR to add aggressive short-term retries + fallback to queue length metric so scale-up can continue even when auth endpoint is degraded.

alex: Thanks all — marking customer update pending until INF-4321 PR lands. :thumbsup:
